reasons.claim: No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

No eligible species were recorded within 1000 m. The only threatened-category records are two mobile NT birds, Turdus iliacus (605 m, 2020, 100 m uncertainty) and Perisoreus infaustus (922 m, 2023, 500 m uncertainty), which are supporting evidence only and say little about the stand. An RE record was excluded from the priority.
Effort within 1000 m is below the county median (27 records vs 66, 24th percentile, 8 observation days). Near-site effort is 0 records inside the polygon and within 250 m.

uncertainties: Records within 1000 m are few and spread over 8 observation days, so coverage of site-bound groups is unknown.
The two bird records have large coordinate uncertainty (100 m and 500 m) relative to the 47 m equivalent radius of the site.
not_established: That the site has no red-listed or site-bound species; absence of records is not absence of species.
The forest's actual condition or habitat value.
next_action: Treat the site as under-surveyed. If a reviewer has capacity, a field inventory would give more evidence than the current records.
